d: Hejaz Group is hiring a Bahrain-based KOL & Creator Partnerships Manager to build and manage relationships with key opinion leaders, creators, public figures, and their representatives across the GCC and Western markets. You’ll develop partnerships across the Group’s brands, including Hejaz, Halal Money, and Wahda.

This is a hands-on commercial role. You’ll source talent, get meetings, pitch partnership ideas, negotiate terms, and stay accountable through launch and renewal. You’ll assess each opportunity based on who the creator reaches and what the partnership can deliver.

Build a regional talent pipeline. Identify relevant KOLs and creators across the GCC, the UK, and other priority Western markets. Build direct relationships with talent, managers, agencies, and community organisations.
Develop partnership proposals. Turn brand objectives into credible pitches for ambassador programmes, creator-led campaigns, exclusive content, event appearances, and in-app activations.
Negotiate and close deals. Agree fees, deliverables, usage rights, exclusivity, timelines, and reporting. Coordinate approvals with the relevant internal teams before any commitment is made.

Manage partnerships through launch. Own the creator relationship and coordinate briefs, scheduling, approvals, and deliverables with Campaigns, Content, and regional teams. For Wahda partnerships, work with User & Creator Operations on onboarding and in-app publishing.

Assess audience fit and brand suitability. Review audience location, engagement quality, past partnerships, and alignment with the brand. Coordinate content review with Compliance where financial products or claims are involved.

Track results and recommend renewals. Measure performance against the deal objective, such as app registrations, qualified enquiries, event participation, or sustained creator activity on Wahda. Use the results to decide which partnerships to expand or renew.
A track record of personally sourcing, negotiating, and closing creator or KOL partnerships.
An established GCC network and evidence of securing partnerships in the UK or other Western markets.
Strong commercial judgement and experience negotiating fees, deliverables, rights, and exclusivity.
An understanding of Muslim audiences across the Gulf and Western markets and how creator influence varies by market.
Strong written and spoken English. Arabic is highly desirable.
Based in Bahrain or willing to relocate, with availability for regional and international travel.

American International University (AIU) is a private institution in Kuwait, founded in 2019, offering undergraduate programs in Engineering and Computing, Architecture and Design, Business, Arts and Sciences, and Education. The programs are delivered in English and follow the American model of higher education. AIU serves a community of more than 4,000 students and is implementing the RISE Strategy 2026–2030, a five-year institutional transformation strategy anchored in research development, international accreditation, student success, employability, and community engagement.

This position will process, track, and manage all paperwork and transactions required for company such as licenses, permits, PUC, as well as employee related legal processes such as residencies, visas, and civil IDs.
Process all types of visas including employment and residency visas, and track for extension, cancelation or transfer as applicable.
Process, track and renew company related permits, Authorized Signatory, and licenses.
Process and track issuance and cancelation of work permits, government health Insurance, medical test & fingerprint registration, and civil ID issuance and cancelation.
Process documents and follow up with stakeholders on PUC approvals and renewals for the university staff.

Keep up to date with changes or amendments to prevailing laws/rules/regulations, changes in forms/formats, and other procedures and keep the Human Resources Department advised of such changes.

Diploma plus a minimum of 3 years of experience in an educational institute

Interested candidates should visit the Job Opportunities section on our website and submit a resume and cover letter via: https://aiu.edu.kw/careers/jobs
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. The successful candidate is expected to commence employment immediately.

We are looking for a Regional Operations Manager to lead and oversee Ninja Retail operations across the assigned region. The role will focus on operational performance, team leadership, KPI management, compliance, and continuous improvement across multiple stores and operational locations.
q: 7–10 years of progressive experience in retail operations, multi-site operations, store operations, fulfillment, logistics, or a related field.
Strong experience managing multiple stores, locations, or operational teams across a geographic area.
Strong understanding of operational KPIs, workforce productivity, service levels, inventory, quality, and compliance.
Proven experience leading managers and driving performance improvement.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and leadership skills.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; Power BI experience is an advantage.
Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Logistics, or a related field.
r: Lead regional store operations and ensure consistent execution of operating standards.
Monitor operational KPIs, service levels, productivity, and performance across stores.
Identify performance gaps and drive corrective and recovery plans.
Lead, coach, and support managers and supervisors within the region.
Ensure compliance with SOPs, quality standards, safety requirements, and company controls.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve operational issues and support store readiness.
Drive continuous improvement in service, productivity, quality, and operational efficiency.
